stock.description: Truly International Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the manufacturing, distribution, and trading of liquid crystal display (LCD) solutions and a range of electronic consumer products. Its business operations are segmented into two main divisions: LCD Products and Electronic Consumer Products. The company's extensive product offerings include touch panel modules, compact camera modules, and various personal health items such as electric toothbrushes, blood glucose monitors, and blood pressure monitors. Additionally, it provides calculators, electronic components, both rigid and flexible printed circuit boards, and plastic injection molding products for diverse uses. Its catalogue further encompasses cover lenses, general healthcare products, fingerprint identification modules, and a variety of electrical devices. The company's market reach extends across the People's Republic of China, South Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, Europe, and other international territories. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
